# RarityGrid

RarityGrid is an independent Pokémon TCG research and collector-tools website.

## Primary sections

- Card search and sourced raw/graded market observations: https://raritygrid.com/cards
- Pokémon TCG sets and expansion checklists: https://raritygrid.com/sets
- Verified editorial coverage: https://raritygrid.com/articles
- Collector market signals: https://raritygrid.com/market
- Drop alerts: https://raritygrid.com/drops

## Data and citation policy

- A missing card price or PSA grade is shown as unavailable; it is not estimated.
- Market observations identify their provider, currency, basis and freshness when available.
- Automated editorial requires at least two HTTPS sources and one official Pokémon or primary tournament source.
- RarityGrid is not affiliated with or endorsed by The Pokémon Company.

## Crawling

Public research pages may be indexed. Account, admin, cart, order and private collection routes must not be indexed.
